backlog.title: Rewind note consolidation + nudge text simplification
backlog.description: Two localized, independent changes to the post-005 codebase. (1) Remove the NoteInput.avoid field, folding its lesson into what_happened — note goes from 4 fields to 3. (2) Shorten renderBloatReminder and renderDriftNudge text strings. No new files, no new mechanisms, no architecture change. Both ride entirely on existing code that session 005 shipped.

milestones.title: Consolidate the rewind note to three fields
milestones.description: The `avoid` field is removed from `NoteInput`; its lesson folds into `what_happened`. Update the schema, the renderer, validation, the rewind tool's typebox schema + description, the RWIND_DESC string, and all fixtures/assertions in the affected test files.

tasks.title: Note consolidation (notes.ts note machinery + rewind.ts schema + tests)
tasks.description: Remove `avoid` from the NoteInput type, the NOTE_FIELDS array, renderNote's **Avoid:** line, readNoteField's key union, and every JSDoc/format reference. Update the RewindParams typebox schema and RWIND_DESC. Update all test fixtures and assertions across notes.test.ts, rewind.test.ts, and edge-cases.test.ts.

subtasks.title: notes.ts note machinery + JSDocs (remove avoid field)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/006_5b685875f3df/architecture/system_context.md §Touchpoint Map. `src/notes.ts` is the pure-helper tier. The `NoteInput` interface (line ~35) currently has 4 fields: `what_happened`, `avoid`, `true_current_state`, `next`. The `NOTE_FIELDS` constant (line ~66) is a readonly array of `keyof NoteInput` that drives `validateNote`'s loop. The `renderNote` function (line ~166) builds sections including `**Avoid:** ${readNoteField(note, "avoid")}` (line 185). The `readNoteField` helper (line ~205) has a key union `"what_happened" | "avoid" | "true_current_state" | "next"`. Module-header JSDoc (line ~6) says 'all four non-empty'; NoteInput JSDoc (line ~33) says 'All four fields'; NOTE_FIELDS JSDoc (line ~65) says 'The four required'; validateNote JSDoc (line ~74) says 'all four'; renderNote FORMAT JSDoc (line ~151) lists the `**Avoid:**` section.
2. INPUT: No upstream dependency — this is the first subtask. Operates directly on `src/notes.ts`.
3. LOGIC: (a) Edit `NoteInput` interface: remove the `avoid` field entirely; rewrite the `what_happened` docstring to 'Past tense: what went wrong and wasted context — and what to avoid doing again. Be concrete; generalize the lesson.'; rewrite the `true_current_state` docstring to 'The TRUE current state as of this rewind — task progress, decisions, and conclusions (files/commands are auto-captured in the ledger below). This prevents redoing work.'. (b) Remove `"avoid"` from the `NOTE_FIELDS` array (now 3 entries: `what_happened`, `true_current_state`, `next`). (c) In `renderNote`, remove the line `\`**Avoid:** ${readNoteField(note, "avoid")}\`,` (line 185) from the `sections` array. (d) In `readNoteField`, change the key union from `"what_happened" | "avoid" | "true_current_state" | "next"` to `"what_happened" | "true_current_state" | "next"`. (e) Update ALL JSDoc references: module header 'all four non-empty' → 'all three non-empty'; NoteInput JSDoc 'All four fields' → 'All three fields'; NOTE_FIELDS JSDoc 'The four required' → 'The three required'; validateNote JSDoc 'all four' → 'all three' (two occurrences: the @description and the inline 'All four present'); renderNote FORMAT JSDoc — remove the `**Avoid:** <avoid>` line from the FORMAT block; update 'all four' → 'all three' wherever it appears in the validateNote/renderNote JSDocs. Pure helpers; never-throws discipline (isRecord/readOwn) preserved unchanged. validateNote's LOOP logic is unchanged — it iterates NOTE_FIELDS, so removing 'avoid' from that array automatically stops checking it.
4. OUTPUT: `src/notes.ts` exports `NoteInput` with 3 fields, `NOTE_FIELDS` with 3 entries, `renderNote` output with no `**Avoid:**` line. Consumed by P1.M1.T1.S2 (rewind.ts schema) and P1.M1.T1.S3 (tests).
5. DOCS: [Mode A] The JSDoc updates ARE the inline docs (spec/04 §2.1 NoteInput, spec/05 §1 step 2, spec/10 §1.8). Update all 'four' → 'three' references and remove the `**Avoid:**` line from the renderNote FORMAT block. No separate docs subtask.

subtasks.title: Renderer text + JSDocs (renderBloatReminder + renderDriftNudge)
subtasks.context_scope:
CONTRACT DEFINITION:
1. RESEARCH NOTE: See plan/006_5b685875f3df/architecture/system_context.md §Touchpoint Map. `src/notes.ts` has two renderer functions. `renderBloatReminder(toolName, bytes)` (~line 282) currently returns: `\`\n---\nThis result added ~${resultKb} KB to your context. If you don't need the full output, call \`mulligan_shrink\` with a summary or \`mulligan_rewind(granularity:"last_tool_call_group")\` if the whole call was a mistake.\``. `renderDriftNudge(metric)` (~line 325) currently returns a string ending with: `\`. If that growth was wasteful, call \`mulligan_rewind\` (undo the turn) or \`mulligan_shrink\` (compact a result); run \`mulligan_audit\` for a breakdown.\``. The `bytesToKb`/`kTokens`/`resultWord`/`readDelta`/`readBloatHits` helpers are UNCHANGED. The `nudges.ts` call site is already 2-arg (005 M4) — `renderBloatReminder(event.toolName, bytes)` and `renderDriftNudge(metric)` — so NO call-site change.
2. INPUT: Depends on P1.M1.T1.S1 (same file `src/notes.ts` — M2 edits disjoint renderer functions below the M1 note machinery).
3. LOGIC: (a) Rewrite `renderBloatReminder` body to return VERBATIM: `\`\n---\n~${resultKb} KB added to your context. \`mulligan_shrink\` to summarize, or \`mulligan_rewind\` if the whole call was a mistake.\`` (spec/07 §1 — drops 'This result added', 'If you don't need the full output, call', 'with a summary or', the `(granularity:"last_tool_call_group")` detail; ~30 → ~20 tokens). (b) Rewrite `renderDriftNudge`'s fixed tail to return VERBATIM: `\`. If wasteful, \`mulligan_rewind\` to undo the turn or \`mulligan_shrink\` to compact a result.\`` (spec/07 §2 — drops 'that growth was', '(undo the turn)' → 'to undo the turn', '(compact a result)' → 'to compact a result', and the entire '; run \`mulligan_audit\` for a breakdown' clause). The 3-branch lead selection is UNCHANGED (delta != null → 'Previous turn added ~<k> tokens...'; delta==null + bloat>0 → 'Previous turn produced <N> bloated <resultWord>'; both empty → fallback). (c) Update both JSDoc FORMAT blocks: renderBloatReminder FORMAT — change the VERBATIM text to the new short form; update cost note 'bloat ~30 tokens' → '~20 tokens'. renderDriftNudge FORMAT — change the tail text to the new short form. `toolName` parameter still accepted-but-unused (spec unchanged on this). Never-throws discipline preserved.
4. OUTPUT: `src/notes.ts` with shortened renderer strings. Consumed by P1.M2.T1.S2 (test assertions).
5. DOCS: [Mode A] The JSDoc FORMAT blocks ARE the inline docs (spec/07 §1, §2). Update the VERBATIM text and cost notes. No separate docs subtask.

(c) Line ~225 (§5 How It Works, Nudge B): '...e.g. `Previous turn added ~4.2k tokens to your context.
